# IBridgeRouter
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/interfaces/IBridgeRouter.sol)

**Inherits:**
IERC165

**Title:**
IBridgeRouter

Interface for the BridgeRouter contract that coordinates cross-chain operations

Defines external functions for adapter callbacks, BridgeQueue calls,
and governance. Access control is managed through ProtocolAccessManaged.
User-initiated operations are intended to go through the BridgeQueue.


## Functions
### executeTransferAssets

Execute asset transfer initiated by the BridgeQueue.

Requires caller to be the configured BridgeQueue (`onlyBridgeQueue`).
Expects `msg.value` to cover the *base* fee required by the adapter.
The implementation should pass the provided `originator` to the internal execution logic and adapter.


```solidity
function executeTransferAssets(
    BridgeTypes.ExecuteTransferParams calldata params,
    BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions calldata options
)
    external
    payable
    returns (bytes32 operationId);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`params`|`BridgeTypes.ExecuteTransferParams`|Struct containing all parameters for the transfer execution.|
|`options`|`BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions`|Struct containing bridge options including adapter choice and parameters.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`operationId`|`bytes32`|Unique operation ID.|


### executeReadState

Execute state read initiated by the BridgeQueue.

Requires caller to be the configured BridgeQueue (`onlyBridgeQueue`).
Expects `msg.value` to cover the *base* fee required by the adapter.
The `originator` parameter represents the original requester; the implementation determines how the response
is routed (e.g., back to the originator, or potentially to the BridgeQueue itself depending on the design).


```solidity
function executeReadState(
    BridgeTypes.ExecuteReadStateParams calldata params,
    BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions calldata options
)
    external
    payable
    returns (bytes32 operationId);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`params`|`BridgeTypes.ExecuteReadStateParams`|Struct containing all parameters for the state read execution.|
|`options`|`BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions`|Struct containing bridge options including adapter choice and parameters.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`operationId`|`bytes32`|Unique operation ID.|

### deliver

Single entry-point for inbound asset transfers and messages

Called by registered adapters to deliver assets and messages to recipients.
The registry ensures recipients are valid targets.
For assets, transfers tokens and emits TransferReceived.
For messages, calls recipient and emits MessageDelivered.


```solidity
function deliver(BridgeTypes.OperationType operationType, bytes calldata operationPayload) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`operationType`|`BridgeTypes.OperationType`|Type of operation (MESSAGE, READ_STATE, TRANSFER_ASSET).|
|`operationPayload`|`bytes`|Encoded operation payload|


### quote

Estimate the base fee for a bridge operation without executing it.


```solidity
function quote(
    uint16 destinationChainId,
    address asset,
    uint256 amount,
    BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions calldata options,
    BridgeTypes.OperationType operationType
)
    external
    view
    returns (uint256 nativeFee, uint256 tokenFee, address specifiedAdapter);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`destinationChainId`|`uint16`|ID of the destination/source chain.|
|`asset`|`address`|Address of the asset (address(0) for non-asset ops).|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount to transfer (0 for non-asset ops).|
|`options`|`BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions`|Bridge options including adapter choice and params.|
|`operationType`|`BridgeTypes.OperationType`|Type of operation (MESSAGE, READ_STATE, TRANSFER_ASSET).|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`nativeFee`|`uint256`|Estimated base fee in native currency.|
|`tokenFee`|`uint256`|Estimated base fee in the asset token (if applicable).|
|`specifiedAdapter`|`address`|The adapter that was specified in the options.|

### pause

Pause all bridge operations (transfers, reads, messages)

Guardian or Governor role required.


```solidity
function pause() external;
```

### unpause

Unpause bridge operations

Governor role required.


```solidity
function unpause() external;
```

### recoverAssets

Recover stuck assets (native ETH or ERC20) from the router

Governor role required. Uses SafeERC20 for token transfers and a low-level call for native ETH.


```solidity
function recoverAssets(address token, address recipient, uint256 amount) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`address`|Address of the ERC20 token to recover; use address(0) for native ETH|
|`recipient`|`address`|Address to receive the recovered assets|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount of assets to recover|


### supportsInterface

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`interfaceId`|`bytes4`|The ERC-165 interface identifier to query.|

**Returns**

|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|bool True if the interface is supported.|


## Events
### AdapterRegistered
Emitted when a new adapter is registered


```solidity
event AdapterRegistered(address indexed adapter);
```

### AdapterRemoved
Emitted when an adapter is removed


```solidity
event AdapterRemoved(address indexed adapter);
```

### TransferInitiated
Emitted when a transfer is initiated by the BridgeQueue


```solidity
event TransferInitiated(
    bytes32 indexed operationId,
    uint16 destinationChainId,
    address indexed asset,
    uint256 amount,
    address indexed recipient,
    address adapter
);
```

### MessageInitiated
Emitted when a message is initiated by the BridgeQueue


```solidity
event MessageInitiated(
    bytes32 indexed operationId, uint16 destinationChainId, address indexed recipient, address adapter
);
```

### ReadRequestInitiated
Emitted when a read request is initiated by the BridgeQueue


```solidity
event ReadRequestInitiated(
    // Corrected from sourceChainId for clarity
    bytes32 indexed operationId,
    uint16 destinationChainId,
    address destinationContract,
    bytes4 selector,
    bytes readParams,
    address adapter
);
```

### OperationDelivered
Emitted when any cross-chain operation is delivered


```solidity
event OperationDelivered(bytes32 indexed operationId, BridgeTypes.OperationType indexed operationType);
```

### ChainRouterAddressUpdated
Emitted when a chain's router address is updated


```solidity
event ChainRouterAddressUpdated(uint16 indexed chainId, address routerAddress);
```

### RouterAssetsRecovered
Emitted when assets (ERC20 or native) are recovered from the router by governance

If `token` is address(0), the recovery represents native ETH.


```solidity
event RouterAssetsRecovered(address indexed token, address indexed recipient, uint256 amount);
```

### DefaultGasLimitUpdated
Emitted when the default gas limit is updated


```solidity
event DefaultGasLimitUpdated(uint256 newDefaultGasLimit);
```

### BridgeQueueUpdated
Emitted when the BridgeQueue address is updated (typically during construction)


```solidity
event BridgeQueueUpdated(address indexed newBridgeQueue);
```

## Errors
### AdapterAlreadyRegistered
Error thrown when an adapter is already registered


```solidity
error AdapterAlreadyRegistered();
```

### UnknownAdapter
Error thrown when an adapter is not registered


```solidity
error UnknownAdapter();
```

### Unauthorized
Error thrown when a caller is not authorized (e.g., not a registered adapter)


```solidity
error Unauthorized();
```

### ReceiverRejectedCall
Error thrown when the receiver rejects a call (e.g., in deliverReadResponse)


```solidity
error ReceiverRejectedCall();
```

### InvalidParams
Error thrown when invalid parameters are provided


```solidity
error InvalidParams();
```

### InvalidOriginator
Error thrown when the originator is not the caller


```solidity
error InvalidOriginator();
```

### InvalidStatusProgression
Error thrown when trying to update status in invalid direction


```solidity
error InvalidStatusProgression();
```

### InvalidStatus
Error thrown when an invalid status is provided


```solidity
error InvalidStatus();
```

### Paused
Thrown when the contract is paused


```solidity
error Paused();
```

### InsufficientFee
Thrown when the provided fee is insufficient


```solidity
error InsufficientFee();
```

### TransferFailed
Thrown when a native token transfer fails (e.g., refund)


```solidity
error TransferFailed();
```

### UnsupportedAdapterOperation
Thrown when an adapter doesn't support a requested operation


```solidity
error UnsupportedAdapterOperation();
```

### NoSuitableAdapter
Thrown when no suitable adapter is provided or available for the requested operation


```solidity
error NoSuitableAdapter();
```

### InsufficientBalance
Thrown when there are insufficient native funds in the router


```solidity
error InsufficientBalance();
```

### UnsupportedOperationType

```solidity
error UnsupportedOperationType();
```
